what: Mistake: queued async-drain A4-A9 depending on the first A3 job id; when A3 was rejected and re-asked, plan treated the dependency as met and ordered A4 first. Also named a nonexistent file in the first fix request (closed bdaq). Lowered A4/A5, queued the plan fix.
